# The Parisialite

> > The Parisialite is a curated Paris travel and shopping guide featuring local recommendations for discovering authentic Parisian boutiques and neighborhoods.

Created by Erin Oates, The Parisialite offers insider shopping guides with interactive maps to help travelers shop like Parisian women in iconic neighborhoods like Saint-Germain and the Left Bank.

## Key Topics

- Saint-Germain
- Paris shopping
- Left Bank
- Boutique shopping
- Parisian style
- Local recommendations
- Curated shopping guides
- Digital travel guides
- Where Parisian women shop
- Paris neighborhoods
- Interactive shopping maps

## Shopping Guides

- [The Saint-Germain Shopping Guide | Where Parisian Women Shop](https://theparisialite.com/product/saint-germain-shopping-guide): Saint-Germain shopping guide: 30+ curated Paris boutiques with map
